country.evidence_quote: We are proud to announce that “Anghel Saligny” Theoretical High School in Cernavodă hosted, on November 19–20, the transnational meeting of the project “Education through Empathy – Together Against Violence,” project code: 2025-1-Ro01-KA210-SCH-000354805. We warmly welcomed teachers and coordinators from Greece, Slovakia, and Portugal, with whom we worked intensively on topics essential to education: empathy, violence prevention, and innovative teaching practices.
